title: Question 15
passage:
Why is there a blank line under each name on the sign-up sheet?
A. I signed up just before noon. B. That’s where you write a contact number. C. We’re still accepting new members.
passageZh:
為什麼報名表上每個姓名底下有一行空白？
A. 我快中午時就報名了。
B. 那一行是填聯絡電話的。
C. 我們還在招募新會員。
